entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A framework for Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation, decomposed into indexing, retrieval, and generation stages.

entities.name: Graph-Based Indexing
entities.description: The initial phase of GraphRAG aimed at identifying or constructing a graph database and establishing indices.

entities.name: Graph-Guided Retrieval
entities.description: The phase following indexing that focuses on extracting pertinent information from the graph database in response to user queries.

entities.name: Graph-Enhanced Generation
entities.description: The final stage of the GraphRAG process where the generator produces the answer based on the retrieved subgraph.

entities.name: Graph database
entities.description: A structured database of entities and relationships used as the data source for GraphRAG, which can originate from public knowledge graphs or proprietary data.

properties.source: Public knowledge graphs, graph data, or proprietary data

relationships.description: GraphRAG utilizes Graph-Based Indexing as its initial stage.
GraphRAG utilizes Graph-Guided Retrieval as its second stage.
GraphRAG utilizes Graph-Enhanced Generation as its final stage.
GraphRAG utilizes a graph database as its external knowledge source.
